sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
**Revenue.** FY2026E $66.0B (+7.9% y/y on FY2025 $61.16B), FY2027E $71.0B, FY2028E $76.5B. Immunology (Skyrizi + Rinvoq) is the engine — ~$30B FY26E to ~$40B FY28E; Humira decay is a rounding item. Aesthetics, neuroscience and oncology/haematology add mid-single-digit growth. Segment and adjusted figures are **analyst estimates — the export carries neither** (Bear pt.2).

**Margins / earnings.** Adjusted operating margin ~41% FY26E to ~42% FY28E; adjusted EPS FY2026E $13.20, FY2027E $14.40, FY2028E $15.70 (~9%/yr). No buyback accretion beyond ~0.5%/yr — net debt caps it.

**Cash / dividend.** FCF FY26E ~$17.8B (dossier FY2025 FCF 17,816M; export 16,870M — **not** operating cash flow $19.5B, Bear pt.3) vs dividend ~$12.2B ($6.92 × ~1.767B shares) = **~1.4x coverage**, not 1.60x. On GAAP net income (FY2025 $4.23B) coverage fails — the ~$7B/yr gap is amortisation plus IPR&D. The cushion is adjusted-earnings, not reported.

**Balance sheet.** Net debt $62.3B, negative book equity (−$3.27B), net debt/EBITDA ~2.0x. Leverage constrains valuation, not solvency.

**Valuation.** FY27E EPS $14.40 at 18.0x = $259; fair value **$262** (≈18.2x forward). **Target $315** = FY29E EPS ~$17.5 at ~18.0x, earnings-only. **Kill $200** ≈ 13.9x FY27E — a de-rating stop, not a falsification (Bear pt.7).

sections.heading: Priors disclosure

sections.markdown: Before opening the dossier I believed ABBV is a Humira-LOE survivor whose Skyrizi/Rinvoq ramp has re-accelerated growth, priced as a premium defensive compounder near its highs, carrying a levered balance sheet with negative book equity and a ~2.5% dividend.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** ABBV is a de-risked immunology compounder — Skyrizi and Rinvoq replaced Humira, aesthetics/neuroscience diversifies, the dividend is untouchable, and it deserves a premium multiple (it sits at its 52-week high).

**Why wrong:** not the franchise — the price. Three undiscounted items: (1) the FY28-29 immunology runway, where Rinvoq and Skyrizi face their own loss-of-exclusivity overhang; (2) payout coverage comfortable only on adjusted numbers — reported FY2025 net income ($4.23B) does not cover a ~$12.2B dividend; (3) $62B net debt and negative book equity cap buyback-funded accretion. At a full multiple, no discount, no dated catalyst: paid earnings growth at full price.

**Deep-dive answers (idea card):**
1. *Ramp vs the Humira cliff?* Yes on the ramp (~$30B FY26E → ~$40B FY28E holds ~9%/yr adjusted EPS); no on the price — their early-2030s expiry sits inside the hold, undiscounted.
2. *Non-immunology contribution?* Aesthetics, neuroscience and oncology add mid-single digits — enough to hold the base, not to replace immunology.
3. *Is the dividend FCF-covered?* FCF ~$17.8B vs ~$12.2B = **~1.4x** — covered, but on adjusted earnings (reported NI $4.23B fails). $62B net debt caps buybacks.

**What proves us wrong:** two consecutive quarters of >20% y/y Skyrizi+Rinvoq growth with raised guidance and net debt/EBITDA below 1.8x; or a credible non-immunology readout adding a second growth leg.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.detail: >=3, observable, current, each citing a dossier line
sections.markdown:
1. Net margin compressed every year — 20.4% (2022) → 9.0% (2023) → 7.6% (2024) → 6.9% (2025); revenue grew while net income fell (dossier: "net margin compressed from 20.4% (2022) to 6.9% (2025)").
2. Stockholders' equity turned negative in 2025 (−$3,270M); book value/share −3.359, price-to-book −82.31 (dossier balance-sheet table / valuation stats).
3. The dividend is not covered by reported earnings: FY2025 net income $4,226M vs ~$12.2B dividend cost ($6.92 × 1,767M shares) (dossier net-income line; "Dividend rate: 6.92").
4. Leverage is rising: net debt $54,070M (2022) → $62,267M (2025); total liabilities $121,518M → $137,188M (dossier).
5. Reported earnings are dominated by non-cash charges: FY2025 operating income $20,091M vs net income $4,226M — a ~$15.9B gap; trailing P/E 78.10 is not a valuation input; every "cheap on adjusted EPS" claim is a claim about add-backs (dossier).
6. Quarterly earnings are volatile on charges: Q1-2026 net income $695M vs Q2-2026 $3,613M — IPR&D/amortisation timing swings the print (dossier).
7. Momentum, not value, put this in front of us: mom6 +35.01% at off-52w-high 0.0% with "no discount" — we are not buying a de-rated name, we are underwriting a full one (screen).

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is 2029 and this position lost 30%. Most likely: we paid a full-quality multiple for the immunology ramp as it matured — Skyrizi/Rinvoq growth decelerated into the high single digits as their own exclusivity overhang came into view, no non-immunology asset stepped up, and the market re-rated the company from ~18x to ~13x. Second: with $62B net debt and negative book equity there is no buyback lever, so one weak print compounds into a de-rating, not a dip. Third: coverage worked only on adjusted earnings; one large IPR&D charge plus a slower aesthetics year pushed FCF coverage toward 1.1x and the market priced a payout cut. The tell: an entry with no margin of safety — Phase 2 sets entry below fair value (254 vs 262).

sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
1. **Archetype misfit.** Base rate is an IDX-SOE prior (window: "High-payout SOE / mature cash cows"). ABBV is US pharma at a 2.54% yield — not high-payout, not an SOE: wrong population. A 2.5% coupon on a name with negative book equity (−$3.27B) whose dividend reported net income ($4,226M) covers at ~35% is no income anchor — a momentum name at off-52w-high 0.0% dressed defensive.

2. **Unattested estimates.** Immunology "$30B FY26E → $40B FY28E", revenue $66/$71/$76.5B, adjusted margin 41-42%, adjusted EPS $13.20/$14.40/$15.70 — none appear in the dossier, which has no segment or adjusted figures. It claims "built from the dossier export alone" yet cites numbers the export lacks.

3. **FCF conflated.** "FCF FY26E ~$19.5B" matches the dossier's operating cash flow (19,507M), not FCF (table 17,816M; export 16,870M). Real coverage is 1.38-1.46x, not 1.60x; "1.75x on adjusted NI" is unsourced.

4. **Multiple contradicts the dossier.** Dossier Forward P/E 17.01 at spot 276.47 implies forward EPS ~$16.25, ~13% above the thesis's FY27E $14.40 — never cited. "No re-rating, earnings-only" is really add-back-only: op income $20,091M vs NI $4,226M, a ~$15.9B gap (its own fact 5).

5. **No variant perception.** "Market believes… premium compounder" is what the thesis believes too — it concedes "wrong on the price," not the franchise: a margin-of-safety argument, not an edge. The card itself: "not ADVANCE — no discount, no dated catalyst."

6. **"WITH" is dishonest.** Regime tilts contain zero healthcare/US names; the book is 100% cash. WITH is inferred from a tilt's absence, not a desk call. ABBV's factor is us_rates — exposed to the Fed hike the desk flags. At best NEUTRAL.

7. **Kill is a stop.** Kill $216 ≈ 15x is a 15% stop, not a falsification level (an immunology break prints in the 10-Q first). Its kpi kill sources "Q3-2026 10-Q segment revenue" — data the dossier cannot supply.

8. **Payoff thin.** EV +12.12% over 2.5y (~4.6%/yr) barely clears the desk's stale cash proxy 3.63% (effective ~3.88%). Equity risk on a levered, negative-equity name for ~+0.7%/yr over cash is no long.

**Hygiene:** card metrics stale vs screen (mom6 27.8 vs 35.01, off-high −1.3% vs 0.0%, vol 21.6 vs 20.15, corr −0.04 vs −0.06); target/kill map onto the lint's 3pp tolerance.

Drew: MAJOR_REVISION — archetype prior from the wrong population, unattested segment/EPS/FCF numbers, and a thin EV that barely beats cash; the franchise and its disconfirming facts are honest, so not a kill.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
Post-attack (Drew, MAJOR_REVISION). All eight points answered; concessions applied to frontmatter and prose.

1. **Archetype — conceded.** `dividend_income_anchor`'s population is high-payout SOE / mature cash cows (60-85% payout); a 2.54%-yield US pharma with negative book equity and ~35% reported-NI coverage is not. Re-tagged to **`momentum_continuation`** (carried in the base-rate library: rate 0.50, +30/−22, 0.75y) — the MOMENTUM sleeve that surfaced it. Prior 0.60→0.50.

2. **Unattested estimates — conceded.** The export carries no segment or adjusted figures; the "dossier export alone" line is corrected — analyst estimates. They sit *below* the dossier-implied forward EPS (pt.4), so the provenance error does not flatter the trade.

3. **FCF conflation — conceded, recomputed.** $19.5B is operating cash flow (export 19,507M), not FCF. Dossier FCF FY2025 17,816M (export 16,870M) vs ~$12.2B dividend = **1.38–1.46x**, not 1.60x; the unsourced "1.75x on adjusted NI" is struck.

4. **Forward P/E — conceded (omission).** 276.47/17.01 = **$16.25** implied forward EPS, ~13% above our FY27E $14.40; we decline it (add-back-embedded, unverifiable) and keep the conservative estimate.

5. **No variant perception — conceded.** The card concedes price, not franchise: a margin-of-safety discipline, not an edge — reflected in p_up = 0.50.

6. **"WITH" — conceded.** Regime tilts hold no healthcare/US name; the book is 100% cash; ABBV's us_rates factor faces the Fed hike. Idea-card regime changed WITH→**NEUTRAL**.

7. **Kill is a stop — conceded.** Price kill re-labelled a **de-rating stop** (~13.9x FY27E) and widened 216→**200**; the falsification is the kpi (immunology growth), issuer-sourced.

8. **Payoff thin — conceded.** p_up 0.58→0.50 and down_pct −15→−21 cut expected_pct 12.12→**2.15**, below the ~3.88% cash proxy. At 254 the name does not clear; it is a WATCH, not a buy.

**Hygiene — conceded.** Phase 2 carries the fresh screen values (mom6 35.01, off-high 0.0%, vol 20.15, corr −0.06); the stale card metrics are superseded.

sections.heading: Judge verdict
sections.markdown:
**Verdict: KILL** (reason_tag: valuation)

1. The Revision is honest — all eight points conceded — but curing by concession stripped the thesis of its reason to exist. Point 5 concedes there is **no variant perception**: "wrong on the price" is a margin-of-safety discipline, not an edge. The constitution requires a three-part variant perception; post-Revision this thesis has none, and p_up sits at the registry prior (0.50) undeveloped.
2. EV fails to clear cash on the analyst's own numbers. p_up 0.50, up 24 / down −21, div 2.2, drag 1.0 → expected_pct **2.15%** over 0.75y (~2.9%/yr) against a ~3.88% cash proxy. The Revision's own sentence: "At 254 the name does not clear; it is a WATCH, not a buy." Cash is a holding that earns; a negative-excess-EV long is a loss, not a hedge.
3. Payoff is near-symmetric (24/21 = 1.14) on that coin flip, and the registry prior already prices the full +30/−22. The Revision's shaved up (24) and deepened down (−21) leave nothing to pay for equity risk in a levered, negative-equity name.
4. The price kill is a de-rating stop (13.9x), not a falsification — conceded. The real falsifier (immunology-growth kpi) sources issuer segment data absent from every document in the packet, and the load-bearing ramp ($30B→$40B) remains an uncited estimate (pt.2 conceded). Central assumption unverified.
5. Entry 254 sits 8.1% below spot 276.47 — un-actionable today, and at spot the EV is worse. No price clears cash without an edge.
6. Not a 6a construction return: the prior is exactly 0.50 (not sub-0.50) and target/kill are valuation-derived — this name is wrong, not mis-specified. Chain verified: draft 10:16 → attacked 10:52 → judged 12:22, monotonic, Bear log present and verbatim.
